prompt: Create a warm, heartwarming cinematic 3D animated family scene in a beautiful cozy home. A cheerful young mother with expressive brown eyes, soft facial features and brown hair tied into a slightly messy high bun sits on a soft woven rug beside her adorable toddler. The mother wears a comfortable cream-colored cable-knit sweater with blue jeans, while the little child wears a mustard-yellow knitted sweater underneath cute blue denim overalls. The toddler has soft curly brown hair, big sparkling blue eyes and an innocent joyful smile. They are surrounded by colorful wooden alphabet blocks, small wooden toys, a soft plush bunny, stacking rings and other child-friendly toys. The mother leans toward the child with both hands gently extended as if encouraging him to play, while the child looks toward her with excitement and happiness. Set the scene inside a beautifully decorated warm-toned living room with wooden shelves, neatly folded blankets, small books, framed minimalist artwork, a soft floor lamp, indoor plants and large windows allowing beautiful golden morning sunlight to stream into the room. Add tiny floating dust particles glowing naturally in the sunlight. Soft shadows, warm ambient lighting, realistic fabric and toy textures, expressive faces, detailed 3D animation, cinematic depth of field, premium animated-film quality, natural composition, wholesome family atmosphere, ultra-detailed 4K/8K look, horizontal cinematic composition.
